senses.gloss: ch. sameto blot out, wash off, erase.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 164a:4">B. Bath. 164ᵃ</cite> <he>דילמא מחיק ליה וכ׳</he> he may erase it and write over it what he may choose.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 164a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>ולִמְחוֹק ולִידַמֵּי</he> let one erase (some writing) and compare; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00876"><he>מְחִיק</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="M00877"><he>מְחִיקָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:2">Gen. R. s. 65</cite>, beg. <he>ייתי הדין מ׳ שמא ויסב להדא מְחִיקַת שמא</he> let this man whose name deserves to be blotted out come and marry that woman &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 112:1">Yalk. ib. 112</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 113:1">113</cite> (not <he>מחקת</he>).—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:5:1">Koh. R. to XII, 5</cite> <he>אדריאנוס שחיק עצמות מ׳ שמיה</he> Hadrian, his bones be ground, his name be blotted out.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:2">Esth. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>נבוכדנצר שחיק מ׳ וכ׳</he> Nebuchadn., he be ground, blotted out &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:9:9">Y. Pes. IV, end, 31ᶜ</cite>; Esth. R. l. c., v. <cite ref="C00205"><he>גְּדִיל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28">Gen. R. s. 28</cite>, end <he>כאיניש … יִתְמְחֵק שמיה דפלן</he> as one says, that man’s name be blotted out.
